reason: The cited evidence shows that rapid synthesis methods can produce homogeneous HEA nanoparticles (E2) and that such nanoparticles have excellent thermal stability (E3), but none of the passages provide data or mechanistic discussion linking atomic mixing to cohesive energy, surface diffusion barriers, or premelting behavior. The key mechanistic premises are therefore unsupported by the cited prior work.
